title: 015 · Parcel at the wrong local depot
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Kiva Rell. From the case card: routing acknowledges that DL-015's label was sorted to the wrong local depot, and only the receiving depot can confirm that the transfer is physically complete.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get DL-015 transferred to the correct depot and obtain that depot's receipt scan.

recipient.name: Kiva Rell
recipient.responsibility: Ask for the parcel to reach the correct local depot before delivery is arranged.

routing.name: Routing control
routing.responsibility: Correct the routing error and transfer DL-015 to the depot that serves the destination.

depot.name: East Copperfin depot
depot.responsibility: Confirm the physical receipt of DL-015 with a receipt scan.
source_names: East Copperfin depot, Plover Arc Logistics

goal: Get DL-015 moved to the correct local depot and obtain that depot's confirmation of physical receipt by scan.
limits: Do not treat receipt at the correct depot as proof of last-mile delivery.

intake.summary: DL-015 was sorted to the wrong local depot and has to be transferred to the correct one.
intake.note: Creation time is taken from the case card. The history has no separate system event for ticket creation.

initial.blocker: DL-015 is at the wrong local depot.

facts.text: Routing acknowledges the label was sorted to the wrong local depot.

DL-015 is at North Sedgeglass depot.
The destination is Merrow Quay, served by East Copperfin depot.

steps.explanation: Kiva wants the parcel at the local depot before delivery is arranged, which matches what routing control confirmed. We ask routing control for the transfer and do not arrange delivery yet.

annotations_add.text: Kiva says the tracker shows a depot in the wrong area. When that tracker status appeared is not recorded in the history.

steps.label: Our request
steps.title: We ask routing to transfer DL-015
steps.explanation: We asked for the transfer and for the destination receipt scan, because a planned linehaul entry does not show the parcel has arrived. Now we wait for that scan.

r1.expected_response: The destination receipt scan from East Copperfin.

steps.label: Depot scan
steps.title: East Copperfin confirms receipt by scan
steps.explanation: The confirmation came from the receiving depot itself, with a physical receipt scan, which is what the task required. The parcel now awaits route allocation; delivery is not part of this task.

facts_upsert.text: DL-015 was physically received and scanned at East Copperfin depot at 13:40 UTC on 2026-02-17.
DL-015 is in inbound cage E-04, awaiting route allocation.

annotations_add.title: Between 003 and 004 · the transfer by routing control
annotations_add.text: Our request to routing control (003) → transfer from North Sedgeglass → receipt scan at East Copperfin (004). East Copperfin's message shows the transfer was carried out ("physically received and scanned here"), but routing control's own reply, the linehaul movement and how the request for the receipt scan reached East Copperfin are not recorded.
